messages:
Ava (product): Quick sync — customer asked for UI-driven rollout controls + model pinning. Engineering prefers API-first. We need a decision framework: RICE / impact vs effort / sequencing. Thoughts?

Diego (eng): +1 for API-first. Programmatic control is lower maintenance, faster to iterate. Rough effort: API endpoints + SDK pages ~3w, full console UX ~4–6w.

Priya (devex): Customers we onboard value a demoable console. Console reduces developer friction for non-engineering users. Could we do a thin console (view-only + toggle) as MVP? :thinking_face:

Marcus (design): Thin console seems doable if we reuse existing feature-flag patterns. I can mock a single-pane rollout UI in 2–3 days.

Leila (cs): CS + sales want UI for demos. That materially affects onboarding conversion — raises impact score.

Diego (eng): Proposed sequence: 1) API + SDK samples + reproducible demo (scriptable) 2) Console MVP (view + change percent + audit). API-first gives us launch criteria and less scope to iterate.

Ava (product): Agree. Let's try a quick RICE sketch to compare options — this is shorthand: 
```
Option A (API-first): Reach=6, Impact=8, Confidence=7, Effort=3 -> (6*8*7)/3 = 112
Option B (Console-MVP after API): Reach=5, Impact=7, Confidence=6, Effort=4 -> (5*7*6)/4 = 52
Option C (Full console now): Reach=7, Impact=8, Confidence=5, Effort=8 -> (7*8*5)/8 = 35
```
Numbers are illustrative but show API-first wins on efficiency.

Priya (devex): Those numbers match customer asks. For adoption, we should track: api calls to rollout endpoints, SDK downloads, console toggles once MVP is live. Also capture qualitative CS feedback.

Diego (eng): Launch criteria (API-first): stable endpoints (contract reviewed), SDK examples + quickstart, integration tests, 2 pilot customers using API-based rollouts. Console MVP criteria: read-only UI + single toggle + audit log + basic RBAC.

Ava (product): Scope negotiation notes: we will not build advanced analytics or visualizations in console MVP. Those are backlog items tied to a later rollout. We'll commit to a signal-driven follow-up if adoption metrics exceed threshold.

deploy-bot: feature-flags-service: CI green, integration tests 82% passing. Next deploy window Tue 17:00 UTC.

Leila (cs): For enterprise customers asking for private deployment, we should prioritize API contract stability and audit logs. That reduces console urgency.

Marcus (design): I'll hand off a tiny component kit for the rollout panel so frontend can reuse it later for a fuller console.

Ava (product): Decision summary: API-first with SDK + demos now. Console MVP (view + toggle + audit) scheduled next quarter. Track adoption metrics and CS win-rate; if adoption/ARR impact > X% we accelerate console. Everyone ok with this? :thumbsup:

Diego (eng): :thumbsup:

Priya (devex): +1. I'll draft the quickstart and sample snippets today.

Leila (cs): Happy with that plan, will line up pilot customers.

Marcus (design): Done — I'll post mocks in #design tomorrow.

Ava (product): Great — I'll create the PRD and RICE sheet and share for comments. Closing the thread unless anyone objects.
